name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 20 times in 6 visits over 38 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 37 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 44 hours starting 2025-05-16, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.39 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
